(271)༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/badzra yo gi nī sto tra/bod skad du/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa/rdo rje mkha' spyod ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hrīḥ

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (271)༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ badzra yo gi nī sto tra/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa/ rdo rje mkha' spyod ma la phyag 'tshal lo// hrīḥlas gyur ba'i mkha' spyod ni// nyon mongs gdung ba sel ba'i phyir// mkha' la dri med pad zla'i steng*// lang tsho shin tu mdzes pa la// bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i tshul// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos phyir// ston zla'i mdog ltar 'od zer 'phro// ma rig gnyid las sad mdzad phyir// grags stong hūm̐ dang phaṭa sgra sgrog /bde dang stong pa lhan cig skyes// gnyis su med pa'i zung 'jug thugs// mkha' la spyod phyir zhabs gnyis ni// rgyab nas phrag pa gnyis la bkal// 'gro rnams mkha' spyod 'dren pa'i phyir// bha ga rgyas shing shin tu yang*// thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i phyir// sku smad rus pa'i rgyan dang bcas// chags shing bde ba rgyas pa'i phyir// sku sha rgyas shing nu ma 'bur// ma rig rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir// phyag g.yas gri gug mkha' la 'phyar// gnyis med bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i phyir// phyag g.yon thod pa mkha' la 'dzin// 'gro ba'i don la dgyes mdzad phyir// zhal ni 'dzum khro dag dang ldan// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gzigs pa'i phyir// spyan gsum mkha' la drag tu gzigs// sku lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir// dbu la thod skam lnga yis brgyan// chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir// dbu skra mthon mthing shin tu gnag /nyon mongs bag chags brnyil ba'i phyir// rus bcas lcang los sku stod non// sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i phyir// 'gying tshul dar gyi cod pan mdzes// yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa'i phyir// dbu rgyan snyan cha dpung rgyan dang*// (272)mgul rgyan do shal do shal phyed// phyag gdub zhabs gdub rgyan rnams ni// rin po che yis rab tu spras// rnam rtog spangs phyir mi mgo'i phreng*// brgya phyed dag gis ga shal byas// nyon mongs bud shing bsreg pa'i phyir// me ri dkar po'i gseb na bzhugs// sgyu ma'i don dang ldan pa'i phyir// 'ja' 'od tshogs kyis kun nas bskor// mkha' spyod ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// dad brtson dam tshig ldan pa yis// mchod bstod gsol ba btab gyur na// yang dag mkha' spyod gnas su ni// 'dren mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// mdun gyi mkha' la lha mo khyod bzhugs nas// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs pa dang*// bems rig bral tshe bar gcod med pa ru// yang dag mkha' spyod gnas su drang du gsol// mkha' spyod ma dkar mo'i bstod pa/
paṇḍi ta dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tstsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur pa'o//
